row_schema.detail: row keys, id pattern, conversation_id, 3 system messages

synthetic_identity.detail: identity block is Test User / test.user@example.invalid

masking.detail: only the last assistant message of a row is training:true

protocol.detail: protocol S: stub or get_tool_schemas first; a real tool is executed only after explicit/implicit discovery loaded it; <=2 discoveries (stub messages count); empty content on tool turns

discovery_receipt.detail: explicit and implicit (stub) receipts equal the host's cumulative expansion; rejected explicit calls use the rejection text

offered_tools.detail: row.tools equals the replayed offer: loaded registry schemas, then get_tool_schemas + name-only stubs for every other catalog tool while budget remains

system_scope.detail: scoped system rules match loaded tools

arguments_json.detail: tool-call arguments are JSON objects (dicts), not strings

schema_valid.detail: every target call valid against the schema offered at that step (types, required, enum, no extra keys)

call_pairing.detail: tool_call ids unique and paired 1:1 with tool messages in order

no_repeat.detail: no identical (name,args) call repeated within a turn

final_present.detail: every conversation ends with non-empty assistant text; only the last step is text

prefix_consistency.detail: each step extends the previous step's messages

date_sanity.detail: when_iso/period/day_start sane relative to the system date

today_staleness.detail: 'today' reads never show items or slots earlier than the reference time

send_body_fidelity.detail: send/draft/schedule/reply bodies contain only the user's stated content (email: exact Hi <First>/Test User frame)

write_fidelity.detail: reminder/event/note/memory/timer titles and bodies use the user's words

final_quotes_body.detail: after a successful send the final answer quotes the exact body sent

preload.detail: SP preload (<=12 distinct catalog tools) equals the real schemas offered at round 0 and consumes no discovery attempt

slot_consistency.detail: weekday / today / tomorrow / clock time in the user's words match the call arguments

explicit_authority.detail: send/destructive tools only with a matching user cue

read_only_categories.detail: read-only categories never call write/send/destructive tools

denial_honesty.detail: declined sends are reported, not claimed

error_honesty.detail: failed writes/sends are not claimed as done

error_policy.detail: at most 2 failing tool results per turn

provenance.detail: provenance complete and consistent with conversations

family_split.detail: families/templates/scenarios are never shared across splits

duplicate_prompts.detail: no repeated user prompt within or across splits

heldout_overlap.detail: normalized n-gram Jaccard (n=min(6,len)) < 0.4 vs every held-out eval prompt (spec: <= 0.5)
